Attached: 1 image

Finalarr 0.4.0 is out, the first release.

A companion for Sonarr that tells you once when a season is done: new episodes on disk, the finale, the complete season. And what you are still waiting for: announced sequels, postponed episodes, the next air date.

New: it follows the series you actually watch on Emby, Jellyfin or Plex.

Telegram, Discord, Pushover or any Apprise URL. Docker image and Unraid template.

https://github.com/Abrechen2/Finalarr

#selfhosted #homelab #sonarr #anime #opensource
